title: PSYCHOLOGY QUESTIONNAIRE
description: 4 Pillars - SLEEP / BURNOUT / MENTAL WELLBEING / LIFESTYLE

burnout_assessment.title: BURNOUT ASSESSMENT TOOL
burnout_assessment.description: Measures current burnout indicators including exhaustion, motivation, focus, and emotional regulation.
questions: I feel mentally exhausted
At the end of the day, I find it hard to recover my energy
I feel physically exhausted
I struggle to find any enthusiasm for my work
I have trouble staying focused
I have trouble concentrating
I feel unable to control my emotions
I may overreact unintentionally

mental_wellbeing.title: MENTAL WELLBEING
mental_wellbeing.description: Explores day-to-day mood, optimism, clarity, relationships, and overall mental resilience.
questions: I've been feeling optimistic about the future
I've been feeling useful
I've been dealing with problems well
I've been thinking clearly
I've been feeling close to people

sleep.title: SLEEP
sleep.description: Evaluates sleep schedule consistency, duration, awakenings, and subjective sleep quality.
questions: I've been going to sleep and waking up about the same time every day
I sleep 7-9hrs per night
I am awake for less than 30mins between the time I go to bed and the time I get out of bed
I stay awake all day without dozing
How long does it take to fall asleep?
How many nights per week do you awaken in the middle of the night
If you wake up during the night, how long are you awake for
How would you rate your sleep quality?
I am satisfied with my sleep

lifestyle_wellbeing.title: LIFESTYLE & WELLBEING
lifestyle_wellbeing.description: Looks at physical habits, nourishment, workload balance, social connections, and financial wellbeing.

physical_health_activity.title: Physical Health & Activity
physical_health_activity.description: Focuses on frequency and structure of intentional physical exercise.
questions: How often have you engaged in structured physical activity (gym, sport, running) this month?

nutrition_hydration_substance.title: Nutrition, Hydration & Substance Use
nutrition_hydration_substance.description: Reviews nutrition quality, hydration consistency, and alcohol consumption habits.
questions: How would you rate your overall nutrition this month (meal quality and balance)?
How consistently have you stayed hydrated each day?
How often have you consumed alcohol this month?

workload_travel_environment.title: Workload, Travel & Environment
workload_travel_environment.description: Examines travel demands and how the work environment affects overall balance.
questions: How many nights have you spent away from home this month?
How much has work-related travel away from home impacted your wellbeing?
How manageable has your overall workload felt this month?

social_family_financial.title: Social, Family & Financial Wellbeing
social_family_financial.description: Assesses support networks, personal time, financial stress, and holistic wellbeing.
questions: How connected and supportive have you felt to your family or close friends?
How much time have you had for personal interests or hobbies outside work?
How much have financial pressures affected you this month?
How would you rate your overall sense of wellbeing this month?
